name: multi-cycle-fixpoint
title: Multi-cycle Fixpoint
description: Recipe 多轮执行直到不再产生变化或显式达到收敛条件。
tests: Execute target-repository tests before production claims.
stop_conditions: Stop when the Skill-specific acceptance contract cannot be proven.
definition_of_done: Skill-specific acceptance criteria pass in the target repository.
production_claim_boundary: Imported static Foundation Skill; not implementation evidence.
